title: Understanding the Task
text: You need to calculate the number of featured artists for each song. This is indicated by the word 'feat.' in the artist column.

title: Using the $$'has_{feat'}$$ Column
text: The $$'has_{feat'}$$ column indicates whether a song has featured artists. Use this to determine if you need to count the featured artists.

title: Counting Featured Artists
text: To count the number of featured artists, split the artist string by commas and count the parts. Subtract one if there is a main artist.

title: Calculate $$num_{feats}$$
text: Use the 'artist' column to calculate the number of featured artists. Consider using string operations to split and count.
